latest.name: Photoroom — AI Product Photo Editor & Background Remover
latest.short_verdict: A commerce-focused AI photo editor for removing or replacing backgrounds, cleaning product images, and preparing marketplace-ready visuals. Its Free Space allows personal, non-commercial experimentation with up to 100 monthly exports (the official table also lists 25 in its weekly column); AI-credit and daily utility caps are not published as exact numbers. The decisive catch is that free use is non-commercial only.
latest.what_it_does: Photoroom edits existing photos rather than acting only as a text-to-image generator. Its tools include automatic background removal and replacement, retouch/erase, AI expand, image enhancement, resizing, preset shadows, AI-generated product scenes, product staging, fashion models, and batch workflows. The strongest use case is turning a simple product photo into a clean listing image for marketplaces and social catalogues. Feature access varies by Space plan; several advanced and batch features are paid.
latest.why_try_it: It is a focused option for product photography: start with one real product photo, remove its background, place it on a cleaner scene, retouch distractions, and resize for a listing. That is a different job from the general image-generation tools already in the discovery history. The free tier is useful for personal/non-commercial tests, but it is not licensed for commercial BrandEx or client work.
latest.free_tier: The Free Space is free and has limited feature access. Photoroom's Help Center export table lists 25 exports in the weekly column and 100 in the monthly column for Free. The same article says Free accounts renew monthly based on the account-creation date, so the in-app usage meter should be treated as authoritative for the actual reset. Free AI generation is described as a low allowance, and Free Utilities have a daily cap, but the exact AI-credit and daily-use numbers are not published. Free use is personal and non-commercial only.
latest.limits: Free Spaces have limited features and some tools are unavailable; advanced AI features, higher generation limits, Batch Mode and API use require paid access. Every download/save/share counts as an export across the Space. Free Utility tools (Background Remover, AI Expand, Image Enhancer, preset AI Shadows, Resize and Retouch) have a daily limit, but Photoroom does not publish the numeric threshold. Exact free AI-credit allowance is also unpublished. The Free plan cannot be used commercially. Photoroom's terms and privacy policy say uploaded images may be used to improve/train its models; users can opt out in account Data Control settings, but the privacy policy says opting out is not retroactive. Avoid uploading confidential client images or personal documents.
latest.signup_pakistan: Photoroom documents sign-in by email or Google, Apple and Facebook; its public terms checked on 2026-11-16 did not name Pakistan as an excluded country. Pakistan-based signup and regional feature availability were not independently tested, so access cannot be guaranteed. Google Play's Pakistan payment page lists JCB, Mastercard and Visa for purchases. Photoroom says mobile subscriptions are billed through Google Play and web subscriptions use Stripe with most major credit/debit cards and PayPal (PayPal depends on currency/account). Whether a particular Pakistani card or Photoroom checkout will succeed was not verified.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor claims: Photoroom's About page says it processes 7 billion images per year, serves 1 million brands and 1M+ businesses, and is a #1 mobile app across 40+ countries; these are company-reported figures, not independently audited. Platform adoption: the Google Play listing showed 100M+ downloads, 4.7 stars and about 4.04M reviews when checked on 2026-11-16; these are store metrics, not a controlled quality benchmark. Independent review evidence: G2 listed 4.3/5 from 20 reviews (page modified 2026-11-11); the sample is small and the company profile is claimed by Photoroom. Review themes praise ease and background removal, while noting imperfect cutouts and limited fine editing. Anecdotal community feedback: a recent r/photoroom thread reports a changed batch-to-full-editor workflow frustrating some users, while other commenters report positive results; this is not representative evidence. No independent standardized image-editing benchmark was verified.
latest.android_status: Official Google Play app verified: Photoroom: AI Photo & Video, package com.photoroom.app, published by Photoroom AI Photo Editor. The listing showed 100M+ downloads, 4.7 stars, about 4.04M reviews and an update dated 2026-11-03 when checked. It is free to install with in-app purchases; country-specific Play Store visibility may vary.
